context:
Goal: q_max batch runs finish sooner without wasting runner minutes.
In plain words: q_max CI has a cheap `checks` job (lint and similar) and a bigger `test` job. Today `test` starts only after `checks` passes (decision D-718, the spend gate: do not spend test minutes on a change the cheap checks already reject). You asked three things. Can one failing fail the other? No: they are separate jobs; one failing does not fail or cancel the other, but the run is red if either is red. Should both run together depending on batch or merge? That is option c below. Is it just a testing fault? Nothing on record says `test` is flaky; the 15 to 10 min gain is a projection, unmeasured, and I have not read q_max's CI file myself (runner 11 did).
Problem (rule): starting both together finishes sooner, but a red `checks` would still spend the `test` minutes, which D-718 exists to avoid.
Based on (ruling): q_max D-718 ci-spend-gate; claude-settings ci-once-per-batch (your 21:16 CST Nov 12).
Departs from: q_max main, where `test` always starts after `checks` — a starts both together on every run; c only on the batch run.

options.how: q_max starts `test` beside `checks` on every run.
options.label: Start both together on every run
options.lose: A red `checks` still spends the `test` minutes on every run.

options.how: q_max keeps D-718 as it is.
options.label: Keep cheap first everywhere

options.gain: The proof run gets faster, and lane runs still save `test` minutes on cheap failures.
options.how: The one batch run that proves a merge starts both jobs together; lane runs keep cheap first. Runner 11 confirms q_max has both kinds of run.
options.label: Together only on the batch run; cheap first on lane runs (recommended)
options.lose: Two rules to keep in q_max's CI file instead of one.

reply: You asked if one fail can fail the other and whether both should run together depending on batch or merge. Answered in the item: no, they are independent; and option c is your batch/merge idea. Please answer again.

shown.label: Start both together on every run
Together only on the batch run; cheap first on lane runs (recommended)

title: In q_max, when should the `test` job start: after `checks` always, together with `checks` always, or together only on the batch run?
why: Goes against q_max D-718, which needs your word.
